name: Siamese
description: Siamese cats are vocal, social, and intelligent. They form strong bonds with their people and enjoy interactive play and attention.

careGuide.nutrition: Provide high-protein diets with wet food for hydration. Portion control to prevent weight gain.
careGuide.grooming: Minimal grooming—weekly brushing is typically enough. Regular dental care recommended.
careGuide.exercise: Daily interactive play sessions with wand toys and puzzle feeders to satisfy high energy.
careGuide.health: Watch for dental disease and respiratory issues in some lines. Maintain routine veterinary care.

name: Maine Coon
description: Maine Coons are large, gentle cats known for their friendly nature and tufted ears. They are playful and adapt well to families.

careGuide.nutrition: High-quality diet with adequate protein. Portion meals to maintain healthy weight in large breeds.
careGuide.grooming: Brush several times a week to prevent mats in the long coat. Regular dental and ear care.
careGuide.exercise: Provide climbing structures, interactive play, and puzzle toys to keep them engaged.
careGuide.health: Monitor for HCM (heart disease) and hip dysplasia. Schedule regular vet screenings.
